coverage_rule: Each field disposition covers its exact schema-selected value; structured values cover the complete recursively schema-governed subtree. Composition fields cover child-unit membership only; child fields are classified under their own semantic type. The selected field set must equal the supported schema closure after semantic child boundaries are applied.
